page.layout: One blank printed page (no text block). Along the right edge, a strip of the neighbouring page with handwriting and a library stamp, which are not transcribed.
page.notes: The page is blank apart from its ruled-free paper surface. The right edge shows the edge of the adjacent page, with pencilled numerals and an oval library stamp in the margin strip. These are handwriting and a stamp, not printed text, so they are left out. Faint stains and marks on the paper are not printed text.
